title: Anything you know about who did it
description: All of this is optional, skip anything you don't know. Even one detail here can matter: the account money was sent to is what a bank can actually act on.

suspectUpi.label: Their UPI ID
suspectUpi.help: The UPI ID the money went TO, not your own.

suspectBankAccount.label: Their account number
suspectBankAccount.help: The account that RECEIVED the money, if you can see it on your statement.

suspectMobile.label: Their phone number
suspectMobile.placeholder: Number they called or messaged from
suspectMobile.help: Even if it is now switched off.

suspectSocial.label: Their profile or username
suspectSocial.help: On WhatsApp, Instagram, Telegram, a dating site, wherever it happened.

suspectUrl.label: Any link or website
suspectUrl.help: The link you clicked, the site you paid on, or the app's download page.

platform.label: Where did this happen?
platform.placeholder: WhatsApp, Instagram, a loan app's name…
platform.help: The app, site or service it took place on.

suspectName.label: The name they used
suspectName.help: Whatever they called themselves. It is almost never their real name, and recording it still helps.

suspectClaims.label: What did they say?
suspectClaims.placeholder: What they told you, what they threatened, what they asked you to do…
suspectClaims.help: In your own words. This is often the most useful part of a report.
